idea.name: Boise
idea.one_liner: A cross-platform dictation app for older people and people with disabilities, sold through subscriptions and lifetime deals.
idea.customer: Older people and people with disabilities who struggle to type; also other dictation users.
idea.offer: Dictation across computers and phones using OpenAI's Whisper API.

key_quotes.quote: It essentially allows you to use really, really good dictation with OpenAI's Whisper API. Absolutely anywhere on your computer and also on your phone.
So we primarily serve people who are older or people with disabilities, people who can't really type normally on their computers without any pain.
We're at 11K MRR. But on a monthly basis, we make anywhere from like 16 to 20K.
The Chrome web store where I posted a Chrome extension gives you like free traffic for basically zero work.
And the true growth of voice C is from SEO. Like I've always been an SEO guy, love SEO. We have like 200 blog posts.
We went from like a thousand subs to like 12,000 subscribers in YouTube in like a month.
Over time, it just became obvious to me that I can't compete with Whisper Flow and all of those guys.
